easyPrerequisites: You control two or more Elves.
description:
Activate Thranduil using Immaculate Magistrate's ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thranduil for each Elf you control.
Activate Thranduil using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
